title: Packing assistant
intro: Plan the clothes, shoes and accessories to bring on a trip. ClosetWise focuses on your wardrobe, not on travel booking.

empty.title: No trips yet
empty.message: Add a trip to build a packing list from your own wardrobe and outfits, so nothing gets forgotten.

edit.invalidDates: The return date must be on or after the departure date
edit.templateHint: A template adds a few generic reminders to your list. You can edit or remove them.
edit.templateHintEdit: Choosing a new template adds its reminders to the list; nothing is removed.
edit.reminderHint: Works when "Trip preparation" is turned on in Settings > Notifications.
edit.deleteMessage: Its packing list will be deleted too. Your wardrobe items and outfits are not affected.

checklist.title: Packing list
checklist.allPacked: Everything is packed. Have a great trip!
checklist.addOutfitHint: Adding an outfit also adds each of its pieces to the list.
checklist.noOutfits: You haven't created any outfits yet.
checklist.allOutfitsListed: All your outfits are already on this list.
checklist.templateHint: Adds the template's generic reminders. Entries already on the list are skipped.
checklist.dontForgetMessage_one: {{count}} piece from these outfits isn't on the checklist yet. Tap to add it.
checklist.dontForgetMessage_other: {{count}} pieces from these outfits aren't on the checklist yet. Tap to add them.
checklist.emptyMessage: Add pieces from your wardrobe, whole outfits, a template or your own reminders.
